attributes.action: Provide capital funding to install air cooling in all UK state schools.
attributes.additional_details: Extreme heat is our new normal. The Climate Change Committee warns UK infrastructure is built for a climate that no longer exists, leaving classrooms dangerously overheated. Children suffer severe health risks; Gov.uk guidance states standard fans can worsen dehydration above 35°C. Stifling heat destroys productivity and exam performance. Cash-strapped schools lack capital budgets to retrofit. Government must fund energy-efficient air cooling to keep pupils safe and learning.
attributes.background: Provide targeted capital funding and update building regulations to mandate the installation of energy-efficient air cooling infrastructure in all UK state-funded schools. The Department for Education must support schools in retrofitting classrooms to protect pupils from rising summer temperatures.

rejection.details:
